messages:
deploybot: SAFETY ALERT: release 3.1.4 -> embeddings-route tripped tail-latency rule. p95 +25% over baseline (10m). suggested action: consider partial revert. https://deploys.redwood.internal/r/3.1.4
nina (eng-release): noticed it too. canary is 6% and error rate is flat. logs show longer KV cache misses for small batches. any recent infra flips? :mag:
sam (sre): ops change at 09:40 UTC touched instance scheduling (binpacking). might affect noisy-neighbor on small hosts. checking host metrics now.
rob (pm): customer-facing risk? we already pushed release notes for 3.1.4 earlier today. if we reroute embeddings, need a short note and to update the changelog.
ops-bridge-bot: Created incident INC-3347: "embeddings p95 drift during 3.1.4 canary". Bridge: https://ops.redwood.internal/bridge/INC-3347
nina (eng-release): proposal: route-only rollback for embeddings to 3.1.3 (zero config change), keep chat and generation routes on 3.1.4. Less blast radius and faster rollback.
oncall-zoe: agree. If we do that, keep canary at 0% and pin traffic to 3.1.3 for embeddings, monitor for 15m. I'll run the pin.
sam (sre): pre-rollback checklist: take KV cache snapshot, note active batch sizes, notify enterprise-custs slack channel. I'll watch p95 and host CPU while you execute.
nina (eng-release): suggested command:
```
rwctl route-pin --route embeddings --to 3.1.3 --canary 0 --ramp 10m --note "p95 regression in 3.1.4 canary"
```
rob (pm): i'll draft a 2-line customer blurb: "We briefly routed embeddings to prior stable version due to latency; no change to outputs. Monitoring continues."
oncall-zoe: executing rwctl now. snapshot complete. ping when done.
deploybot: ACTION: route-pin accepted. change-id: CL-9921. status: applying.
nina (eng-release): monitoring p95, p50, and error rate for embeddings. also comparing sample outputs from 3.1.3 vs 3.1.4 on our quick eval. so far identical.
sam (sre): p95 down ~23% within 4m after pin, errors steady. host CPU dropped a bit. looks like route-pin fixed tail latency.
rob (pm): posting customer note to priority accounts and updating release notes to mention temporary routing fix.
oncall-zoe: ramp completed to 100% on 3.1.3 for embeddings. leaving incident open for 30m observation.
nina (eng-release): retro action: add a deploybot preflight check for recent infra flags and instance packing changes. also add a canary config diffs warning that catches model-quantization or scheduling toggles. :memo:
deploybot: NOTE: automated rollback policy remains enabled. this was handled as a targeted route rollback per engineers' decision.
